name: MeTube
description: Download videos from YouTube and hundreds of other sites.

paths.description: Your downloaded videos and audio. Open them in the Files app under Downloads, metube.

paths.name: State
paths.description: MeTube's queue, history, subscriptions and uploaded cookies.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: MeTube web page, published on host as 6731

variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.description: Where MeTube keeps its queue, history and subscriptions. Leave it as /state, the app folder below.
